transcript.text: Which tier is the value tier? Answer with the tier name.

args.intent: value tier customer segmentation tier name

args.sql:
SELECT c.tier, COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.tier
ORDER BY order_count ASC

transcript.text:
The "value tier" is defined as the customer tier with the fewest orders. Querying orders joined to customers grouped by tier, "enterprise" has the lowest order count (287), compared to plus (361) and basic (552).

FINAL ANSWER: enterprise
